matches.rationale: Paired source inspection: int f(void) { int *p=0; return *p; } Corrected counterpart: int f(void) { int value=1; int *p=&value; return *p; } Checker ID, diagnostic meaning and source/sink anchor agree; potential operation defect, not a whole-program execution claim.

void f(void) { int *p=malloc(sizeof *p); if (!p) return; free(p); free(p); } Corrected counterpart: #include <stdlib.h>
void f(void) { int *p=malloc(sizeof *p); if (!p) return; free(p); } Checker ID, diagnostic meaning and source/sink anchor agree; potential operation defect, not a whole-program execution claim.

Paired source inspection: #include <stdlib.h>
int f(void) { int *p=malloc(sizeof *p); if (!p) return 0; *p=1; free(p); return *p; } Corrected counterpart: #include <stdlib.h>
int f(void) { int *p=malloc(sizeof *p); if (!p) return 0; *p=1; int value=*p; free(p); return value; } Checker ID, diagnostic meaning and source/sink anchor agree; potential operation defect, not a whole-program execution claim.
